cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Welcome to our inn. Please apologise to the doorway for knocking after you arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It expected advance notice from your knuckles. Explain that you're sorry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for telling the telephone first. It had to hear about its own visitor secondhand.

mechanism: A enforces the inn's impossible doorway etiquette and treats B's attempted compliance as another apology obligation.
confusable: Unlike normal advance booking, the doorway itself is owed impossible prior notice and precedence over the phone.
comparison: Inn arrival and telephone notice differ from the chair's consent and employment.
seedUse: The seed already puts A in host authority and directs successive apologies to the doorway, merging both instructions.
